description: Mobile-first agricultural harvest tracking web application (PickTrace clone) designed for outdoor field supervisors and agricultural managers in Spanish.

theme_strategy.rationale: High contrast light mode optimized for direct outdoor sunlight and field readability, with an optional dark mode toggle for evening administrative work.

layout_and_spacing.bottom_nav_mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar (height 64px, z-50) with high-contrast icons and clear Spanish labels for key field actions (Cosechar, Día, Reportes, Módulos).

buttons.primary_harvest_action: h-14 w-full bg-[#1E4620] hover:bg-[#153417] text-white text-lg font-bold rounded-xl shadow-md transition-transform active:scale-95 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 border border-[#1E4620]
buttons.secondary_action: h-12 bg-white hover:bg-emerald-50 text-[#1E4620] text-base font-semibold rounded-xl border-2 border-[#1E4620] transition-colors
buttons.accent_cta: h-14 w-full bg-[#E65100] hover:bg-[#C63D00] text-white text-lg font-bold rounded-xl shadow-lg transition-transform active:scale-95
buttons.danger_action: h-12 bg-red-50 hover:bg-red-100 text-red-700 font-bold rounded-xl border border-red-300

inputs.field_input: h-13 text-lg px-4 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#B8B29C] focus:border-[#1E4620] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E4620]/20 bg-white text-[#1A2210] placeholder:text-[#889078] font-medium shadow-sm
inputs.select_dropdown: h-13 text-lg px-4 rounded-xl border-2 border-[#B8B29C] focus:border-[#1E4620] bg-white text-[#1A2210] font-medium

cards.field_card: bg-white rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#E2DDD0] shadow-sm p-4 hover:border-[#1E4620]/40 transition-all
cards.stat_card: bg-emerald-950 text-white rounded-2xl p-5 border border-emerald-800 shadow-md

tables.responsive: Use card-stack view on small mobile screens (<640px) and rich high-contrast horizontal scroll tables on desktop/tablets.

1_auth_login.title: Inicio de Sesión
1_auth_login.components: JWT Login Form, Quick Demo Credentials selector, High-contrast login button

spanish_labels.title: AgriScan - Control de Cosechas
spanish_labels.subtitle: Ingresa tus credenciales para registrar en campo

2_registrar_cosecha.title: Registrar Cosecha (Formulario de Campo)
2_registrar_cosecha.components: Worker Select (con foto mini), Parcel Select, Product/Crop Select, Kilos Input, Date Picker, Photo Upload/Capture preview, Live Auto Payment Calculator Box (Kilos × Precio/Kg = Total $)

3_lista_del_dia.title: Lista del Día y Totales
3_lista_del_dia.components: Kilos Totales del Día Header Badge, Total a Pagar Badge, Search bar by Worker, Worker Summary Cards with total kilos and total pay, Detailed harvest log timeline

spanish_labels.empty_state: No hay cosechas registradas hoy aún

4_reportes_y_exportacion.title: Reportes y Exportación
4_reportes_y_exportacion.components: Filter bar (Fecha Inicio, Fecha Fin, Trabajador, Parcela), Summary Chart (Bar chart for kilos per crop / per worker), Export to Excel button (.xlsx generation / download trigger), Totals breakdown table

5_modulos_crud.title: Módulos de Gestión (CRUD)
tabs: Parcelas (Nombre Lote, Hectáreas, Tipo de Cultivo, Ubicación)
Cosechas (Histórico, Editar, Eliminar registro con confirmación)

6_dashboard.title: Panel Principal / Resumen
6_dashboard.components: Kilos Cosechados Mes, Trabajadores Activos, Parcela Más Productiva, Promedio $/Kg, Gráfica de Rendimiento Semanal

testing_and_attributes.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key data display elements MUST contain data-testid attributes using kebab-case role naming.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all JS/JSX files are created with modular components in /src/components and pages in /src/pages.
Strictly follow the Spanish language labels defined in key_features_and_views.
Include high-contrast tap targets (h-12 or h-14 buttons) for field usability.
Calculate payment automatically in real-time as users edit Kilos or Precio/Kg.
Provide demo initial data preloaded in LocalStorage or state for Workers, Parcels, Products, and Harvests so the user can test immediately.
Implement sheetjs (xlsx) or CSV export function for the Excel export button.
Use Lucide-react icons for clear, bold icons across mobile navigation and buttons.
Add toast notifications via sonner upon saving harvest, adding worker, editing parcel, or exporting excel.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow high contrast outdoor sunlight readability rules, use touch targets >= 48px, never use transparent backgrounds under header or cards, add data-testid to every interactive component.
